atomic_facts.fact: The exact legal name of the business is Tischlerei Kühne e.U.
The company's seat is in Egg, Vorarlberg (6863 Egg).
The registered seat address is Schmarütte 230.
Tischlerei Kühne e.U. was founded (entered in the Firmenbuch) on 03.05.2013.
The registered business purpose (Geschäftszweig) is 'Tischler und Holzgestaltende Gewerbe' (carpentry and wood shaping trade).
